title: Serene Private Backyard Studio. Near BNA, Downtown
description:
Enjoy a peaceful private studio minutes from the airport, downtown and much more. You'll have a well-lit space looking into our serene backyard all to yourself. Quickly accessible to all major highways without the noise and traffic. Samsung 55" Smart TV

NO CLEANING FEE!

This is a perfect space for 1-2 people to unwind and recharge after catching a local sports event, enjoying live music, visiting a local university or simply taking advantage of all that Music City has to offer.

The space
Our home is on a quiet street in the Woodbine/Glencliff neighborhoods. (If you haven't heard of them, we're also considered South Nashville.)

While your room is connected to our home, your space is all to yourself and you'll only see us outside the home if we happen to cross paths.

It's a mostly residential area, but easily accessible to the rest of the city with a car or taxi.

Guest access
You'll have the guest suite at the back of our house all to yourself with no shared spaces. It has a queen bed with a Nest mattress, mini-fridge, microwave, two-seat couch, closet with hangers, table with two chairs,  toilet and shower. It's also south-facing and gets the best natural light in the home.

There's a door with multiple locks separating your room from the rest of the home.

You have a separate outside entrance that has a lock on the handle as well as a deadbolt.

Feel free to spend time anywhere outside on our property as well. Please be respectful of our neighbors if you do so!

Other things to note
• Queen bed with Nest mattress
• Hot-water kettle
• Brita filter pitcher
• Specialty instant coffee – not the cheap stuff – provided. Just add water and stir!
• Windows facing east and south with blackout curtains and blinds
